title: Veerna Tera Khali Jhoola Jhulaawan
body:
Rait Day Wich, Karbala Di, Laash Teri, Kevain Veeran, Chad Ke Mai Tur Jaawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer Kha Ke Karbala Wich,
Rakhleya Ay Maan Maa Da (x2)
Teri Jung Nu Tak Ke Veerun, Rondiyan Nay Kazawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaira Jhoolay Wich Si Sonda,
Aj Oh Saangan Tay Sawaar Ay (x2)
Tenu Veeran Chah Nai Sakdi, Russiyan Wich Nay Baawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Lash Teri Dhup Tay Chak Kay,
Kevain Manzar Maa Bhulaway (x2)
Teray Bajon Maa Nu Asghar, Bhulgaiyan Nay Ay Chaawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kevain Laasha Chaya Pyu Nay,
Kabr Kevain Hai Banaayi (x2)
Ro Ro Akhay, Tenu Asghar, Kevain Kabar’ Ch Lawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut Day Wal Hai Karaayi,
Aap Putraan Di Tayyari (x2)
Wakhriyan Wi, Jug Ton Shahid, Karbala Diyan Mawaan
